topic: Drawing sheet composition and its essential components

questions.q: 1. The art of representation of an object by systemic lines on a paper is known as
questions.explain: Drawing is the technical method of representing an object's shape and features using lines on a flat surface.
Engineering drawing is considered the universal language of engineers because it conveys technical information across different regions and languages without ambiguity.

questions.q: 12. When only one drawing is to be made then its position should be
questions.explain: Placing a single drawing in the center of the sheet ensures proper balance, aesthetic appeal, and space for annotations/dimensions on all sides.

questions.q: 13. Working/ drawing space on the paper is determined by
questions.explain: Border lines are drawn on the sheet to define the actual area available for the technical drawing and to provide a frame for the work.

questions.q: 43. The paper size of A3 is
questions.explain: Standard ISO paper sizes: A3 is 297mm x 420mm (double the size of A4).

questions.q: 44. Size of A4 size paper is
questions.explain: A4 is the most common paper size, measuring exactly 210mm by 297mm.

questions.q: 45. Number of equal pieces of A4 size paper from A0 is equal to
questions.explain: Each step in the A-series halves the area. A0 → A1 → A2 → A3 → A4. That is 2^4 = 16 sheets.

questions.q: 46. The area occupied by A0 (drawing sheet) is ............ times the area occupied by A1 (drawing sheet).
questions.explain: One A0 sheet is equivalent to two A1 sheets placed side-by-side.

questions.q: 47. The area occupied by A0 (drawing sheet) is ............ times the area occupied by A2 (drawing sheet).
questions.explain: Following the division rule (2^2), A0 is four times the size of A2.

questions.q: 48. The area occupied by A0 (drawing sheet) is ............ times the area occupied by A3 (drawing sheet).
questions.explain: Following the division rule (2^3), A0 is eight times the size of A3.

questions.q: 49. The area occupied by A0 (drawing sheet) is ............ times the area occupied by A4 (drawing sheet).
questions.explain: Following the division rule (2^4), A0 is sixteen times the size of A4.

questions.q: 142. "Title Block" is placed at bottom right hand corner of the drawing which gives information about
questions.explain: The title block is the metadata center of a drawing, containing names, dates, scales, and identification numbers.

questions.q: 157. *In standard A series drawing sheet, the ratio of length of shorter side to longer side
questions.explain: ISO 216 standard (A series) uses a constant aspect ratio of 1 to the square root of 2 so that the proportions remain the same when the sheet is folded in half.

questions.q: 166. The selection of suitable scale and allotment of proper space for margin, title block, revision panel, folding marks, etc. on the drawing sheet is known as :
questions.explain: Layout refers to the organized arrangement of all required elements on a drawing sheet.

questions.q: 167. The size of the title block of all sizes of drawing sheet is :
questions.explain: According to Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), the standard size for a title block is 185 mm x 65 mm.
